title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 10: Jeffry McWild
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．１０ 「ジェフリー・マクワイルト」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 10 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to Jeffry McWild. Newly made computer graphics follow him out to sea - facing a shark from his boat, diving among coral reefs with a harpoon and relaxing under the palms - in a sequence staged to his image song "Ano Nami o Koete", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Jeffry McWild
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
